evals.prompt: our og images are all hand-made in figma and half the blog posts don't have one. can you set up something that generates them?
evals.expected_output: Detects the stack and package manager, extracts real design tokens and shows them, asks which artifacts/dimensions/layout with real options, confirms the data source (the content collection or frontmatter, not a copied list) and destination, copies card-renderer.ts and replaces the example THEME, installs deps with the lockfile's package manager (tsx unless the project uses bun), runs the generator, and verifies with verify-images.mjs plus a visual check of the longest title.

evals.prompt: generate 1280x640 README banner images for each package in this pnpm monorepo
evals.expected_output: Asks which app or package owns the images or confirms the repo root when tokens and data are shared, uses pnpm add -D with tsx rather than bun, renders at the agreed size, and verifies count and dimensions with verify-images.mjs.

evals.prompt: make store screenshot tiles for our Flutter app using the brand colors
evals.expected_output: Treats it as a non-JS project: creates scripts/image-gen-tools as a self-contained sub-project, transcribes tokens from ThemeData into one theme file with a comment naming the source, writes into a folder declared in pubspec.yaml assets, and tells the user the run command includes the cd.
